title: No verdict caching in the SDK
description: No verdict caching in the SDK.
acceptance: Verifying the same attestation twice, with a revocation published between the calls, accepts the first and rejects the second
No cached signature, window, proof or revocation result is reused across calls
The test fails if any cache is introduced
findings: From the repository audit of 2026-10-17: cached verification results must not bypass a newly applicable revocation.
